capability.title: Governed Application Intelligence
capability.outcome: Matching, LLM scoring and application artifacts use approved profile/CV facts and remain proposal-first.
acceptance_criteria: Provider outputs cannot overwrite hard filters or canonical facts.
validation: Schema, grounding, fail-closed and cost-boundary tests.

stories.title: Approved Candidate and CV Fact Model
stories.outcome: Canonical profile, constraints, skills, experience and project evidence are versioned and reviewable.
acceptance_criteria: Each fact has provenance, validity and approval state.
Planned capability is distinct from implemented evidence.

stories.title: Deterministic Job-Fit Baseline
stories.outcome: Hard filters and explainable weighted signals produce a baseline before LLM scoring.
acceptance_criteria: Reasons, uncertainty and missing evidence are emitted.
Baseline is stable on representative jobs.

stories.title: Governed LLM Job-Fit Scoring
stories.outcome: LLM adds structured explanation without becoming final truth.
validation: Mock-provider, schema, grounding and budget tests.

stories.title: Evidence-Backed Employer Classification
stories.outcome: Employer enrichment separates verified facts from uncertain inference.

stories.title: CV Optimization Proposal
stories.outcome: Existing approved evidence is selected and worded for a job without invented experience.
acceptance_criteria: Every proposed bullet maps to approved fact/project evidence.

stories.title: Application Letter Drafting
stories.outcome: Tailored letters are generated as review artifacts from approved facts and job evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Claim provenance and human review are mandatory.
validation: Grounding, schema and no-send boundary tests.

stories.title: Application Artifact Review and Provenance Workflow
stories.outcome: Draft, reviewed, accepted and rejected artifact states are auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical and proposal artifacts are separated.
Audit records source evidence and reviewer.

stories.title: CV Update Proposal Agent
stories.outcome: Repository progress produces selective, evidence-cited CV suggestions only.
